notes: Everyone in the call now sounds equally loud (Settings > Voice > Make everyone the same volume, on by default), and a new option cleans up the voices you receive. The voice gate asks the noise model before it opens, so fans and keyboards keep it shut more often, and push-to-talk keeps the microphone open 200 ms after you release the key. On busy Wi-Fi each packet can carry a copy of the previous frame, so fewer gaps. Reviews of accounts, encryption, instructions and dependencies tightened three input bounds. Includes a new client and a schema-31 server; a self-hosted server upgrades its database on first start. Measured on the bench; not yet tried in a live call.
